name: The Woman At The Well
overview: In John 4, Jesus intentionally travels through Samaria, breaking cultural barriers by speaking directly to a Samaritan woman at a well, an interaction marked by her surprise that a Jew would ask her for a drink. Jesus reveals to her the gift of God, offering living water that satisfies spiritual thirst, highlighting His mission to bring salvation beyond traditional boundaries and to reveal Himself as the source of eternal life.
